title: When the Clock Sings
author: Orsen Galloway
blurb: Lena Voss, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
